description: Write validated translations into the project’s locale files. It re-runs every check validate_translations runs, and additionally refuses if the project changed since the plan was made — a clean validate earlier grants nothing. Either every proposed change lands or none does. Your host asks the user before this runs, and git is where they review what it wrote.

candidates.description: One entry per plan item you are answering.

key.description: The merged key, exactly as the plan item spells it.

locale.description: The locale this translation is for.

quantity.description: CLDR plural category, for a plural item. Omit for an ordinary one.

planId.description: The planId from prepare_translation_plan, this session.

name: apply_translations
title: Apply translations to the project files
